cases.command: airtable --help

expect.stdout:
usage: airtable [-h] {base,table,record,comment} ...

Airtable Web API client

commands:
  base     Read bases
  table    Read table schemas
  record   Read and write records
  comment  Read and add record comments

options:
  -h, --help  Show this help and exit

cases.command: airtable record update --help

expect.stdout:
usage: airtable record update --base BASE --table TABLE [--fields FIELDS] [--typecast] [-h] [RECORD]

Update records' cells (PATCH) from RECORD --fields or stdin

positional arguments:
  RECORD

options:
  --base BASE      Base ID (app...) (required)
  --table TABLE    Table ID or name (required)
  --fields FIELDS  Cell values as a JSON object keyed by field name
  --typecast       Let Airtable convert string values to the field types
  -h, --help       Show this help and exit

Without RECORD --fields, reads records.jsonl lines from stdin and patches
each "record_id" with its "fields"; computed fields are dropped.
